nodes.title: Prompt Guide
widgets_values:
## Anchoring The Subject

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman whose body shape and proportions come from <Picture 1>, whose exact facial features come from <Picture 2>, and whose outfit comes from <Picture 3>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - exact face from <Picture 2>, body from <Picture 1>, and outfit from <Picture 3> are retained with natural skin texture.

## Summary of Video

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a short calm video portrait of <Subject 1> standing in a misty forest. <Picture 1> defines her body, <Picture 2> defines her face, and <Picture 3> defines her clothing. She leans against a tree, looks at the camera, then smiles gently.


## Detailing the Description

detailed_description:
Soft cinematic style, shallow depth of field, natural diffused daylight through mist and trees, cool green forest tones, subtle film grain.

[Shot 1] Medium shot of <Subject 1> leaning against a tree in a slightly misty forest. She looks calmly toward the camera. Soft mist drifts between the trees. Camera is static with a very slow push-in.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, cut to a close-up of her face. She gives a soft, natural smile while looking into the lens. Gentle side lighting from the canopy.


## Audio Prompting

overall_soundscape:
Quiet forest ambience — distant birds, light breeze through leaves, soft mist atmosphere. No dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A (or describe what music you want, eg: fantasy flutes and lute playing a beautiful melody)

## GUIDE

if stuck refer to the guide here: [Base Guide](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/docs/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_base_en.md)
